title: Bryce Young says knee is "fine" after loss to Packers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bryce Young says knee is "fine" after loss to Packers
sources.description: Panthers quarterback Bryce Young has been on the injury report since hurting his left knee during the team's Week 3 loss to the Browns and he was asked if it was bothering him after Thursday night's game in Green Bay.
